tweaks.name: Passcode theme (.passthm)
tweaks.description: Replace the lock screen keypad artwork from a .passthm package, across every locale and the bold variants.
tweaks.rollback: No original can be captured: AirLift cannot read pre-existing files. TelephonyUI regenerates this cache, so apply a known-good theme over it instead. Requires Bold Text OFF or iOS renders vector fonts.

tweaks.name: Passcode per-key artwork
tweaks.description: Write individual digit glyphs without needing a full .passthm package.
tweaks.rollback: Write a known-good theme over it.

tweaks.name: Lock screen clock font and size
tweaks.description: Change the lock screen clock typeface, size, position and colour.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Clock typography on iOS 27 is rendered from SpringBoard's compiled resources and the user's text-size settings. No writable preference exposes font choice, size in points or position; it needs SpringBoard code hooks, which are jailbreak-tier.

tweaks.name: Hide the lock screen date
tweaks.description: Remove the date line under the lock screen clock.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Date visibility is not exposed through any writable store; it is decided by SpringBoard's lock screen layout at runtime.

tweaks.name: Wallet card skin
tweaks.description: Replace a single card's background artwork (PNG at 2x/3x plus the PDF variant) inside its .pkpass bundle.
tweaks.rollback: The write mechanism is verified, but the original artwork cannot be captured and the card bundle on iOS 27 is not at this path, so a revert needs the card to be re-added in Wallet.

tweaks.name: Wallet bulk card skin
tweaks.description: Apply the same artwork to every card hash at once.
tweaks.rollback: Same limits as the single-card skin.

tweaks.name: Auto-discover card hashes
tweaks.description: Find Wallet card hashes by streaming the device syslog while Wallet is opened.

tweaks.name: PosterBoard wallpaper (.tendies)
tweaks.description: Install animated PosterBoard descriptors at structure version 61 and force a cache refresh.
tweaks.rollback: Write the unprotectedUserDefaults.plist that makes PosterBoard discard the injected descriptors.

tweaks.name: Auto-discover the PosterBoard container
tweaks.description: Locate the PosterBoard app container UUID automatically instead of asking the user for it.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: The container lives at /var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/<uuid>, and AirLift exposes no directory listing or read primitive, so the UUID cannot be enumerated. The user must paste it in. Measured on iPhone14,3 / 24A437.

tweaks.name: Wallpaper library (.tendies packs)
tweaks.description: Import, preview, organise and apply .tendies wallpaper packs.
tweaks.rollback: Remove the pack from the library; the device copy is replaced by the next apply.
